in_marathi.name: Gowri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of agriculture, fertility, and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gowri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gowri is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘gau’ which means cow. The name signifies the goddess of agriculture, prosperity, and fertility. She is the divine mother of Lord Ganesha and is believed to have bestowed him with the elephant head. The name is also associated with Lord Shiva and Parvati. Gowri is revered for her nurturing and protective qualities and is often invoked for blessings of abundance and prosperity.
